title: 第一百五十章 名锁落印第一百四十九章 先给活人归名
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
第一百五十章名锁落印
柳溪镇的墓碑拆了三天。
不是砸。
每一块都要先拓字、封白火、确认对应活人已经归名，再由本人决定留还是毁。
韩大年留了自己的碑。
他把“病亡已葬”四个字磨掉，改成了一块界石，立在西村水渠边。
有人问他晦不晦气。
他说：“提醒我活着的时候，地也差点没了。”
“侦查一下情报，把这个星辰的情况搞清楚。”扶风挥手示意道。
他呼吸有些粗重，声音里带着意犹未尽的低沉急切，散发着浓浓男性气息，江偌被他撩拨得心猿意马。
那元婴残魂可不像陈锋，还对自己有单挑的执念，要是真的无所保留的出手，莫离还是感觉很麻烦的。
又累又困的李发财三口两口的就把面包解决，他无比的想念面馆老板制作的面条，那香味，那口感，简直就是天堂。
周天的话不只是威胁了白夜，连同其他各路修士都算在了里面，金家也与修士有交往，难道也要被清理？
其余几人在他们大哥的指使之下，拨出了口袋中的水果刀，嗷嗷大叫着冲上前来。
暗宫弟子的确强大，可是碰到这种杀不尽的食人藤曼，显得脆弱不堪，惨叫连天。
所有超人类被组织起来共同抵御魔兽。他们被催生出的能力五花八门，有弱有强。弱的可能只是视力好一点，听力好一点。强的的完全就是一只“人型魔兽”，能单独猎杀魔兽的存在，后来被人们称呼为——猎魔士。
扶风却希望她能够早点离开，把修罗葬天抓出来，并且让释苍古佛的死水落石出。
这大理石比寻常石材好上一些，但还算不上真正的天材地宝，如果不能在短时间内放入白夜的神国，最终也会化为灰烬。
有了钱，一个月之内，冉飞就迁移了三万人！大部分迁移到了北部，那里就是如今的东北平原的一部分，十分肥沃，冉飞将此作为军粮重地，平日里，一部分士兵帮助百姓生产，一部分在四周巡逻。
“是，为天朝效劳，是诚仁迫不及待之事，迫不及待……”诚仁哭丧着脸，心中复杂，上了贼船，又约了炮，跪着也得舔完，还有一丝窃喜，天朝终于有用得着自己的地方了，自己还是很有价值的嘛。

之前电脑管家大战，企鹅就是用这招对付微博的，不过杭雨跟周红衣合作，化解了企鹅的攻击。后来微博自研电脑管家，此时微博电脑管家的下载量已经超过企鹅和360，保证了微博的安全发展。
“这些人都是我黑月城的人，你杀了他们，我就有责任为他们报仇。”罗光冷声说道。
那男子也不多话，大步过去，手里的灿花神钩飞起，挂住了城门的大木栓，猛的一较力，咔叭一声，大木栓就被拉断了，跟着神钩钩住了门环，单膀较力，那需十几个大汉才能拉动的城门，被他生生扯了开来。

Chapter 150: The name lock is sealed
It took three days to remove the tombstones in Willow Creek Town.
Not smashing.
Each piece must be inscribed, sealed with white fire, and confirmed to have been named by the corresponding living person, and then the person decides whether to keep it or destroy it.
Han Danian left his own monument.
He rubbed out the words "died of illness and buried" and changed it into a boundary stone, which he erected beside the water canal in West Village.
Someone asked him if he was unlucky.
He said: "It reminds me that when I was alive, the earth was almost gone."
"Research the information and find out the situation of this star." Fufeng waved his hand.
His breathing was a little heavy, and his voice was low and urgent with unfinished meaning, exuding a strong masculine aura. Jiang Ruo was so excited by him.
The Yuanying remnant soul was not like Chen Feng, and was obsessed with him in a duel. If he really took action without reservation, Li Qiye would still feel it was very troublesome.
Tired and sleepy, Li Facai finished the bread in three mouthfuls. He missed the noodles made by the noodle shop owner. The smell and texture were simply heaven.
Zhou Tian's words not only threatened Bai Ye, but also included other monks from all walks of life. The Jin family also has contacts with the monks. Will they also be liquidated?
Under the instruction of their eldest brother, the remaining people took out the fruit knives in their pockets and rushed forward screaming.
The disciples of the Dark Palace were indeed powerful, but when they encountered this inexhaustible man-eating vine man, they seemed vulnerable and screamed in agony.
All superhuman beings are organized to fight against the monsters together. The abilities they have been given birth to are varied, some are weak and some are strong. The weak ones may just have better eyesight and better hearing. The powerful one was completely like a "humanoid monster", an existence that could hunt monsters alone, and was later called a witcher.
Fufeng hoped that she could leave as soon as possible, catch Shura Zangtian, and let the dead of Shi Cang Ancient Buddha come to light.
This marble is better than ordinary stone, but it is not a true treasure of heaven and earth. If it cannot be placed in Bai Ye's Kingdom of God in a short time, it will eventually turn into ashes.
With the money, Ran Fei relocated 30,000 people within a month! Most of them moved to the north, which is now part of the Northeast Plain. It is very fertile. Ran Fei regards this as an important area for military supplies. On weekdays, some soldiers help the people produce, and some patrol the surrounding areas.
"Yes, serving the Celestial Empire is what Chengren can't wait to do. He can't wait..." Chengren cried with a sad face, and felt complicated. He boarded the pirate ship, had sex again, and had to finish it while kneeling. There was also a hint of secret joy. The Celestial Empire finally had something useful for him, and he was still very valuable.
In the previous computer butler battle, Penguin used this trick to deal with Weibo, but Hang Yu and Zhou Hongyi cooperated to resolve Penguin's attack. Later, Weibo developed its own computer manager. At this time, the number of downloads of Weibo Computer Manager has exceeded Penguin and 360, ensuring the safe development of Weibo.
"These people are from Black Moon City. If you kill them, I have the responsibility to avenge them." Luo Guang said coldly.
The man didn't say much, and strode over. The magic hook in his hand flew up and hung on the big wooden bolt of the city gate. With a fierce struggle, the big wooden bolt was broken with a click. Then the magic hook hooked the door knocker. With one arm fighting, the city gate that required more than a dozen big men to pull was pulled open by him.
